bullets.text: Led 28 engineers across three client-facing platforms with a $9MM annual budget.
Ran vendor selection, contracting and transition for two third-party payment providers.
Sustained 99.9% availability across the platform portfolio and cut incident response time by 30%.
Led the migration of 14 applications from on-premises hosting to the cloud and documented the approach adopted by 12 other teams.

summary.text: Engineering leader with 12 years of experience, including 6 years in leadership roles at a regulated financial institution.
Led 28 engineers across three client-facing platforms with a $9MM annual budget.
Sustained 99.9% availability across the platform portfolio and ran vendor selection, contracting and transition for two third-party payment providers.

gaps: Candidate managed 28 engineers; role requires leading 62—larger org design and delegation scope
No stated experience managing five managers; prior role managed individual contributors and one level of leads
level_evidence: Manages 62 engineers across five teams through five direct-report managers
Owns $9MM annual budget including vendor contracts
Reports to VP, Technology; sets multi-year roadmap with executive stakeholders
output.rationale: Clear director-level scope: large org, multi-manager structure, significant budget and executive partnership. Candidate exceeds requirements: 12 years engineering experience (vs. 10+), 6 years in leadership including 5+ managing managers, direct payments domain expertise, proven $9MM budget ownership and vendor management at similar scale.
strengths: Exact budget and team-size match from prior Director role managing 28 engineers with $9MM budget
Payments domain expertise: led vendor selection and transition for two payment providers
Proven executive stakeholder management and regulatory environment experience at financial institution

gaps: No stated experience with network software or telecom-specific platforms
Limited evidence of board-level or executive committee exposure
No mention of setting company-wide technology strategy or CTO partnership
level_evidence: Reports to CTO; sets technology strategy with executive team
output.rationale: The role is clearly VP-level: large org, director reports, substantial budget, and C-suite partnership. The candidate exceeds the 15+ years requirement (12 stated, but profile shows 6 years in leadership at a regulated financial institution with director-level scope, 28-person team, $9MM budget). Strong match on engineering leadership, cloud platforms, and vendor management; some gap in the breadth of 'network software' domain and board-level visibility.
strengths: 6 years as Director managing 28 engineers with $9MM budget and multi-platform responsibility
Proven vendor management and large-scale cloud migration leadership
Track record of operational excellence (99.9% availability, 30% incident response improvement)

gaps: Kotlin experience not mentioned, though Java/Spring Boot expertise is directly applicable
Moving from Director role to Senior Manager is a step down in scope, though the role's focus on architecture and delivery aligns well
level_evidence: Leads three platform teams with 22 engineers and tech leads
Manages two engineering leads and several senior engineers directly
Owns delivery for quarterly roadmap and stays close to architecture reviews
output.rationale: Real level is senior_manager: manages multiple teams with tech leads beneath, owns delivery of a product area, reports to director. Candidate is an excellent fit: 12 years engineering experience, 6 years in leadership including 5 years as Director managing 28 engineers across platforms, deep Java/Spring Boot and AWS cloud migration expertise, and proven track record in payment and checkout-adjacent domains at a regulated financial institution.
strengths: Exceeds experience requirements: 12 years total, 6 years leadership (3+ required)
Proven platform engineering leadership: managed 28 engineers across three platforms with $9MM budget and 99.9% availability
Strong technical foundation: built Java/Spring Boot RESTful services at scale; led cloud migration of 14 applications to AWS

gaps: No stated experience with iOS or Android development; mobile is the core domain
Smaller team scope (11 vs. 28) and lower budget responsibility than current role
No evidence of design partnership or mobile product delivery
level_evidence: Leads 11 engineers and 2 QA analysts with two team leads beneath
Budget limited to team tooling, not portfolio-level P&L
Hands-on: reviews pull requests weekly while managing
output.rationale: The role is senior_manager scope (13 people, team leads, VP reporting line) but the title 'Director' overstates it. Candidate has director-level experience leading 28 engineers with $9MM budget and cloud platform delivery, but lacks stated mobile development expertise; the core domain (iOS/Android engineering) is not evidenced in the profile.
strengths: Proven leadership of larger teams (28 engineers) with strong delivery track record
Experience mentoring and managing team leads in regulated environment
Hands-on technical engagement (code review, architecture) aligns with role's pull-request expectation
